{"address":"14054f8b0","function_name":"LuxAudio_RegisterActiveVoiceInstance","comment":"Resolve an authored cue and enqueue creation under a CRT-generated application voice ID.

Source: SoulcaliburVI.exe 14054F8B0; lookup 141DE5E00, command append 1405656D0, owner pump 1405637D0, opcode-zero handler 140565440, retirement 140565ED0.

Algorithm: Reject missing owner runtime, manager, cue-sheet entry, or negative cue. Draw current-thread CRT rand until non-FFFFFFFF and lookup 141DE5E00 finds no allocated map record whose VALUE at entry+4 equals the draw. Append the 24-byte opcode-zero command carrying generated ID, cue sheet, cue and flags. Mark owner active, then insert/replace generated KEY at entry+0 with backend VALUE FFFFFFFF. Release the temporary cue-sheet reference and return generated ID; validation failure returns FFFFFFFF.

The collision lookup scans VALUES, not generated keys. Pump opcode zero later starts backend playback and stores the returned backend ID as the map value. Retirement consults backend status and removes completed values. Creation here is queued, not synchronous backend start, and command append precedes map insertion. Do not infer unique generated keys from this value collision check.

Ownership: owner+28 queue, +38 sparse map, +88 lock, backend runtime handles and manager/global tickable lifetime are distinct. Returned application IDs escape to stop/scheduled bindings. Backend publication/completion changes future collision retries and therefore can change CRT consumption on the same thread as MoveVM. Frequency and replay-thread overlap remain live-admission questions, not demonstrated bounded-run failures.

Current UcrtRandBroker forwards native calls before classification and captures the actual PTD state. Its counted allowlist does not isolate gameplay RNG. Older speculative logical-ID/confirmation comments were design proposals, not implementation proof. Any deterministic output reconciliation must regenerate logical events from restored state and changed inputs, preserve complete B undo and independently validate the chosen protocol; do not reuse expected IDs or retry counts.

Current bounded candidate witness (2026-09-22):
Run replay-d5bbc5fcafb94d678c007be7c0739790, game f8904e4b..., runtime92f282d0..., observer9fc1cbe0..., UCRT5e7709a6..., recorded538 valid native rand rows at ticks610..743 across repeated/corrected traversals on thread79708. Audio return54F91E contributed328 rows, emitter initializer1F9BD5C162, and ground placement895D6E/89610548. Seven adjacent ground-to-audio pairs continue exactly from the preceding native CRT state. All rows satisfy the verified native LCG/result relation. {"address":"141f9bd00","function_name":"InitializeTilePoolParticleEmitterInstance","comment":"Summary: Initializes the tile-pool emitter variant at vtable 14394C100+10 and its particle/render bookkeeping.
Source: D:\dev\sc6\UE4_Steam\Engine\Source\Runtime\Engine\Private\Particles\ParticleEmitterInstances.cpp

Parameters:
pEmitterInstance: Complete emitter instance being initialized. The partial type names only independently verified fields and preserves unknown regions.

Returns:
void.

Algorithm:
1. Initialize template/module-derived emitter parameters.
2. Select the current LOD and clear transient counters.
3. Seed the emitter-local FRandomStream at +0x288 from UCRT rand().
4. Allocate required indices from the particle-system shared free pool.
5. Rebuild active-index bit storage, register the render instance, and initialize the emitter-local random output.

Side Effects:
Mutates emitter state and shared particle-system allocation/registration state. Calls UCRT rand() on the invoking thread.

Determinism and Rollback:
This function calls native UCRT rand and stores the result as both local seeds +288/+28C. A draw on the same thread as MoveVM RAND advances that same native stream; there is no separate presentation stream in this body. The prior annotation's instruction to exclude these draws from gameplay RNG is not a valid native-equivalence requirement.

Historical annotation, not current qualification:
A 2026-08-05 Replay100 run reportedly observed the return callsite RVA 0x1F9BD5C on the battle thread. Its binary/observer identities have not been revalidated here.

Ownership scope:
The direct vtable reference is 14394C110, belonging to vtable 14394C100. Factory 141F941E0 allocates 0x2A0 and constructor 141F8D370 installs that vtable, retains identities +1D0/+1D8, and separately allocates 0x260 render storage at +1E0. This initializer removes tile indices from owner +78's shared pool (+40190 count, +190 index array, +40198 critical section), updates local arrays, and registers render storage. Destruction 141F8F920 invokes 141FA10B0 before releasing render storage and arrays. A per-component byte copy cannot undo that external allocation/registration. The existing partial type includes this variant's fields and must not be applied to every emitter vtable.

Evidence:
The embedded source path and FParticleEmitterInstance diagnostics identify the UE subsystem. The layout and Init/InitParameters names agree with Epic's FParticleEmitterInstance API. Assembly verifies SpriteTemplate +0x10, Component owner +0x18, FRandomStream seeds +0x288/+0x28C, and LOD field +0x290.

Special Cases:
The identities at +0x1D0/+0x1E0 are conservatively typed and must not be serialized as peer state. Compiler register/stack phantoms remain intentionally untyped.

Audio return54F91E contributed328 rows, emitter initializer1F9BD5C162, and ground placement895D6E/89610548. Seven adjacent ground-to-audio pairs continue exactly from the preceding native CRT state. All rows satisfy the verified native LCG/result relation.
